exclusion_detail: Lead S9 (cyclopentylamino analogue, ROCK2 IC50 0.020 uM) needs the indazole arm (nitration-type cyclisation to 2, THP protection, nitro reduction = 3 reactions), prolinol substitution (6), Curtius carbamate formation (7), SNAr coupling (8), nitro reduction plus chloroacetylation (9, 2 reactions), then amination and TFA deprotection (2 reactions): at least 10 reactions.

lead.label: S9
lead.why: Abstract: 'cyclopentylamino analogues S9 (ROCK2 IC50 = 0.020 uM) as the most potent ROCK2 inhibitor'; used for the cell and mechanism studies.

notes: All target compounds share the same linear route, so none is 4 steps or fewer.
